lessons.text: Run ./scripts/ci-local.sh before every git push and report the result.
The gateway listens on port 7777; the vite dev server proxies /api to it.
Use uv run pytest, never bare pytest, so the project venv is used.
Session JSON files live in ~/.arz/sessions and store naive UTC timestamps.
Format Python with ruff format, not black.
Frontend builds into src/arz/static; restart the gateway to serve a new build.
Claude Code model aliases opus, sonnet and haiku always resolve to the newest model.
Codex caches its model list in ~/.codex/models_cache.json.
Kiro CLI opens a browser login when list-models runs while logged out.
Memory vectors live in sqlite-vec inside ~/.arz/memory.db.
Bump the version in all seven version sources before each commit.
The Playwright screenshots need the gateway running with token auth disabled.
Lessons are stored in ~/.arz/lessons.jsonl, capped at 200 rows.
Use the gh CLI for pull requests and issue lookups.
Ollama embeddings need the nomic-embed-text model pulled locally.
Widgets render inside a sandboxed iframe; clicks post messages back to chat.
Prefer vitest run for frontend tests and tsc -b --noEmit for type checks.
Autonudge fires after idle time only when the session has an autonudge goal.
The consolidator runs after 30 messages or 3 hours idle.
Use the file viewer path:line links to open code at a specific line.
Docker images are published to GHCR from the release workflow.
Postgres migrations run with alembic upgrade head in the api container.
Use the file tools to read files, not cat in the shell.
The Slack channel bot token lives in config.toml under channels.slack.
Gemini CLI routes the pro and flash aliases to the current model generation.
